name: Can bathroom trim be installed on uneven walls or sloping tile floors?

mainEntity.name: Can bathroom trim be installed on uneven walls or sloping tile floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, experienced trim installers can adjust installation techniques to compensate for uneven bathroom floors and out-of-square walls. Older properties throughout the Denver metro area frequently feature settling, sloped subfloors, or bowed drywall corners. Installers use techniques such as scribing—tracing the floor's contour onto the trim board before cutting—to create a tight, level fit along the floor line without leaving visible gaps. For bowed walls, flexible trim materials and strategic back-cutting allow moldings to sit flush without snapping or pulling away from the drywall over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Installers scribe trim along floor contours and use flexible materials or custom cuts to ensure moldings fit flush against uneven surfaces.
